title: Unable to print JSX to screen using Next.js

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### What version of Next.js are you using?

11

### What version of Node.js are you using?

14.16.0

### What browser are you using?

Chrome

### What operating system are you using?

Mac 10.14.6

### How are you deploying your application?

 'npm run dev'

### Describe the Bug

I bet this is something I don't yet know how to do with Next.js but in the past with my React site I would retrieve data from an API that was in a regular Text field, with no markup (no Markdown) just plain text. I would write my content for that field locally, in text but write it in HTML, and when I needed to display some JSX code I would simply wrap that code in curly braces and tick marks. Then I'd finish marking the rest of the field up in HTML, save it in the DB and call it and it would display inside my React component when needed. However I just can't find a way to retrieve text called from an API that has embedded JSX that will display with the formatting respected. Is this not permitted in Next.js, or is there an unpublished convention on how to do this? Thank you in advance, I appreciate your help. Rich

### Expected Behavior

JSX code will be displayed, even slightly formatted from with my component's JSX.

### To Reproduce

Nothing I've tried has worked so far, I've tried using plain text fields, formatted text fields (Markdown, not using Markdown) and various escaping methods inside my JSX.
